name: Shawn's Toolbox
description: Guiding-questions panel (flip through a note's sections, whole-note fallback), pillars panel (cycle life pillars → per-pillar section cards, slot-reel wheel selector, per-pillar quick-capture inbox with voice dictation + auto-growing input), threads panel (thread areas grouping from an editable mapping note, Today's-thoughts processing view, #thread reading + reply + add-tag menu with new-thread creation, periodic-thought views + cadence + tagged/untagged filters, whole-vault scan, pin threads to top), capture view (blank screen → daily-note sections), editable section cards, focus & voice panels (arm a cadence tag while recording a thought), note status control, checkbox completion stamping, and block summarizer.
author: Shawn
